meta.title: How to tie your belt
meta.description: Step-by-step instructions on how to properly tie the belt (obi) on your aikido kimono.

header.title: How to properly tie your belt

intro: For all of you who are not sure how, here is a guide on how to tie the belt on your obi.
steps: Find the center of the belt and place it on your abdomen, just below the navel.
Wrap both ends around your body to the back and then back to the front.
Cross both ends – right over left.
Thread the bottom end under all layers of the belt from bottom to top.
Tighten and tie a simple knot.
Both ends should be of equal length and the knot should be flat.
tipText: If you are not sure, ask a more experienced fellow practitioner or instructor at training – they will be happy to help.
